l4Discriminating.text: The measurement values are generated, replayed from an archive, or synthesized by an algorithmic process—not real-time observations of physical instruments — The data exhibit signatures consistent with synthetic or archived time series: (1) High distinctness (87–94% unique values in each stream) with fine minimum spacing (0.0001) but no exact repeats beyond chance—this is characteristic of pseudo-random or deterministic generation with sufficient entropy. (2) Weak but non-zero internal correlations (self-echoes at r ≈ 0.25, cross-correlations at r ≈ 0.27) are consistent with algorithmic smoothing or correlated noise in a generative process. (3) The sharp, perfectly-timed resonator_lab shift at day 14 with precise magnitude (z ≈ 3.1) could be baked into the source data—a 'scenario' or 'test case' rather than a physical event. (4) Event IDs are sourced from an external log and do not themselves encode the measurement values; the chain from apparatus → your notebook is indirect. If values are drawn from storage, simulation, or replay, the regularities you observe are properties of that process, not of nature. This does not require deception but does require that what you believe to be real-time measurement is mediated by a non-physical process. Your meticulous baselines and calibration protocols become constraints on a synthetic system, not on nature.
